name: Hundegger ROBOT-Compact 650
summary: Small-footprint timber joinery machine for carpentry firms with little space: the 6-axis robot unit of the ROBOT-Drive with a 28-tool changer machines beams and glulam up to 300 × 650 mm on all six sides in one pass. Made by Hundegger in Germany.

germany.statusNote: German maker; sold on request from Hawangen (Allgäu). No price published.

sellers.name: Hans Hundegger AG
sellers.note: Kemptener Straße 1, 87749 Hawangen, Germany. Price on request.

specs.label: Timber cross-section
specs.quote: For cross-sections from 20 x 60 mm to 300 x 650 mm

specs.label: Robot unit speed
specs.quote: The patented 6-axis ROBOT unit with a speed range from 0 to 12,000 rpm and up to 28 freely selectable tools.

specs.label: Tools in the changer
specs.conditions: usable tool length up to 420 mm
specs.quote: The magazine of the tool changer is designed to hold up to 28 different tools with a usable length of up to 420 mm.

specs.label: Timber length with automatic infeed
specs.quote: ROBOT-Compact 650 with automatic infeed standard, timber length 13 m and timber outfeed 13 m

specs.label: Sides machined per pass
specs.quote: 6-axis technology = processing on 6 sides in a single pass

specs.label: Built for
specs.value: companies with limited space and small production quantities
specs.quote: The ROBOT-Compact 650 allows economical and professional joinery even for companies with limited space and small production quantities.

notes: Stationary machine; options include slot cutter, labelling system, buffer infeed and lift table with automatic stacking.
Short parts are carried to the operator side on a conveyor belt.
